title: NERV FPV pack uses the FPV core package
goal: NERV's battery and fleet rules come from the core package; NERV keeps only the adapter
acceptance: The FPV pack implements the core storage interface over SQLite; existing tables and data are unchanged
The moved rules and their tests are gone from NERV (no dead copies); a join test runs a chat phrase through the pack into the core and back
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-20: swap internal calls for the package and delete the moved code. Not a measurement.
